POST /applications/{application_id}/asse.body: none (application_id lay tu URL; feature doc tu mart.application_features_v1)
POST /applications/{application_id}/asse.persist: INSERT ml.assessments bang credit_ml.inference.to_db_row(result) trong 1 transaction

POST /applications/{application_id}/what.calls: credit_ml.whatif.what_if(bundle, application_id, features_row, income=..., review_threshold=..., decline_threshold=...)

GET /models/metrics.returns: model_manifest.json -> evaluation_metrics (+ model_name, feature_version, trained_at, policy)

success_response.risk_score: float [0,1] - uoc luong cho lop TARGET=1; cao hon = rui ro cao hon
success_response.feature_snapshot: 16 predictor, thieu = null, khong co TARGET

error_mapping.404: application_id khong co trong mart.application_features_v1 (do API xu ly)
error_mapping.422: credit_ml.inference.InvalidFeatures (.codes: FORBIDDEN_KEY, UNKNOWN_KEY, MISSING_KEY, INVALID_TYPE, NON_FINITE, NEGATIVE_VALUE, OUT_OF_RANGE, INVALID_WHATIF_*)
error_mapping.503: credit_ml.inference.ModelNotReady hoac chua co model_run -> body = not_ready_result(...); KHONG INSERT

db_rules.failed: chi khi da chon model_run_id; risk_score/band/recommendation = NULL; reason_codes khong rong
db_rules.not_ready: khong ghi vao ml.assessments (model_run_id NOT NULL)

note: Tai lieu nhom dung ten risk_probability; DB va code dung risk_score. Thong nhat mot ten khi chot openapi.yaml.
